name: bottom-up-letters
title: Bottom-Up Letters
description: Letters rise from below in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time.
useWhen: A short punchy word or acronym should land with clear, visible per-character energy.
A slow reveal cadence where the staircase wave is the hero moment, crisp and without blur.
avoidWhen: The text is a full sentence: the stagger drags; use per-character-rise or mask-reveal-up.
You want blur or softness in the reveal: use blur-out-up or focus-blur-resolve.
The entrance should feel unified rather than letter by letter: use micro-scale-fade.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Short word or acronym that rises in.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames between one letter and the next.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far below its place each letter starts.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
